claims.promise: A guitarist can type a chord chart or import its photo, transpose it, select bars, and turn that passage into a guitar-specific loop rather than starting a generic timer.

evidence.finding: The hand-classified chord-chart-transposer shelf has 8 of 11 on-job visible cards; 4 of 5 sampled rated apps are below 4.2 stars and a review asks to save transposed songs.

claims.deferredReason: No chart importer or loop compiler exists; resolve when a test turns a chord sequence and bar range into the expected timed loop.

claims.promise: The drill repeats a selected passage, raises tempo only after successful timing windows against its click, and shows an explicit confidence score rather than pretending every microphone reading is correct.

evidence.finding: A sampled Guitar Tabs X review asks for tempo switches in the same tab, while the guitar-practice shelf has 26 of 30 hand-classified on-job cards.

claims.deferredReason: No audio onset pipeline exists; resolve when PCM fixture tests verify beat-window scoring and tempo advancement.

claims.promise: Each drill links its chord and scale material to adaptive guitar interval, chord, scale, and rhythm dictation so ear work rehearses the same musical vocabulary as the passage.

evidence.finding: The interval-ear-training query has 21 of 23 hand-classified on-job cards, while the enriched ear-training leaders declare in-app purchases on all 8 sampled listings.

claims.deferredReason: No adaptive question scheduler exists; resolve when deterministic tests advance difficulty from answered interval and rhythm fixtures.

claims.promise: The player records a take, A/B-compares it with the reference tempo, and shares the audio plus a compact timing summary through Android's share sheet rather than trapping the result in a practice diary.

comparison.limitation: A sampled review says the member cannot save or print materials from the phone.

evidence.finding: The TrueFire sample has a 1-star review saying materials cannot be saved or printed; the guitar-practice complaint scan found 2 missing-feature classifications among 11 critical reviews.

claims.deferredReason: No recorder or export exists; resolve when instrumentation verifies ACTION_SEND with a FileProvider audio URI and the timing-summary attachment.

claims.promise: The next session resumes the unfinished passage and displays tempo and accuracy improvement by passage, so practice history serves the drill instead of becoming the product.

evidence.finding: One of 3 sampled critical TrueFire reviews says it is hard to get back to content and recently watched content does not reflect the user's activity.

claims.deferredReason: No local session persistence exists; resolve when a recreation test restores the selected passage, tempo, and completed repetitions.
